notes.title: Update notes for 30th of April
notes.notes:
A number of users reported issues with lower game quality, so we terminated some bugs here and there regarding quality.
We also fixed the save system and can now confirm its fully functional, we apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: WE HAVE ACHIEVEMENTS NOW
notes.notes:
We added Steam achievements to the game, 4 in the first episode to be specific and fixed more issues in the previous build.

we are aware of some issues in the save and load of the game and that will be our first priority before launching episode 2.

notes.title: Fixed a number of issues
notes.notes:
Fixed a number of issues including:
An annoying keystroke sound on keyboard clicks.
Stairs being hard to climb.
furniture being walkthrough.

Side Note: thank you MillieBytes for your comment.

notes.title: We are live, here and on reddit r/WHTK
notes.notes:
What happened to Kate is a series with episode like levels, and it need a community of me and you to improve and develop.

No matter what recommendation, complain or discussion, we are willing to hear it either here or on our reddit r/WHTK

thank you....
